acceptanceCriteria: Wire and both verifiers accept the two authentication forms and refuse any other; the single-valued constant is gone from stable.go and the portable mirror.
Tests: a map that includes its own public key as an artifact stays below VERIFIED; a valid signature over a different gitTree is refused; a valid signature leaves executionAtCommit at NOT_OBSERVED.
cem-stable-v1.md records CEM-V1-064; protocol/cem-1.0 gains the cases; V1-0595 freeze notes cite this ticket as landed.
body: Source: decision 0523 (docs/decisions/0523-cem-1-0-rc3-verifier-computed-support-2026-10-11.md) and build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-11-cem-1-0-expert-panel.md, origin/main fb11b2274. Proposed CEM-V1-064. `authentication` is `{"method":"none"}` or `{"method":"dsse-ed25519","keyid":K,"envelopeSha256":E}`; E names a `receipt-attestation` artifact holding an in-toto Statement whose subjects are the receipt digest, the runner-plan digest and the target gitTree. The axis rises above NOT_OBSERVED only when `--trusted-keys FILE` supplied by the consumer names K; a key carried by the map stays UNTRUSTED_KEY; a valid signature never raises executionAtCommit. Signed production stays an operator step (FPK-V0-036) and is a recorded limit. Freezing the current single-valued constant in V1-0595 would make authenticated receipts inexpressible in 1.0.
title: cem/1.0 P1: receipt `authentication` becomes a verifiable DSSE slot with a consumer-supplied trust root (must land before the V1-0595 freeze)
